name: agent-frosted-glass
prompt: Effect for a shape layer that looks like frosted glass: it blurs and brightens whatever is beneath the layer inside the layer's alpha.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

definition.label: Frosted Glass

summary: I wrote "Frosted Glass" (id gen.frosted-glass, group Blur & Sharpen) with backdrop: true. Inside the shape's alpha it blurs the pixels beneath the layer with 64 spiral samples, brightens and tints them, and adds a rim highlight and grain. The output uses premultiplied alpha. All 10 params can be keyframed. None of it has been checked: no tools were attached this run, so validate_effect, GLSL compilation and rendering didn't run. The code also assumes u_backdrop uses the same v_st/u_texel coordinates as u_tex.
